_comment: Config-driven test backend selection (gels-style, see refer/gels/src/config/configs.ts). Change db_dialect to run the SAME contract suite against another backend. Backend is chosen by --dialect <name>, ZORM_DB_DIALECT, or this field. sqlite3-mem = in-memory SQLite; sqlite3 = file-backed SQLite (connString is a file path).

sqlite3-mem.name: sqlite3-mem
schema: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "table_for_test";
CREATE TABLE "table_for_test" ("id" char(64) NOT NULL, "name" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "age" integer DEFAULT NULL, "score" real DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "second_table";
CREATE TABLE "second_table" ("id" char(64) NOT NULL, "name" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "third_table";
CREATE TABLE "third_table" ("id" char(64) NOT NULL, "value" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
sqlite3-mem.catalogSql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'view' AND name = 'v_table_name_not_exist_in_db'

mysql.name: mysql
schema: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `table_for_test`;

CREATE TABLE `table_for_test` (`id` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NOT NULL, `name` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL DEFAULT NULL, `age` int(0) NULL DEFAULT NULL, `score` double NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = Dynamic;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `second_table`;
CREATE TABLE `second_table` (`id` char(64) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(128) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`)) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `third_table`;
CREATE TABLE `third_table` (`id` char(64) NOT NULL, `value` varchar(128) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`)) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4;
mysql.catalogSql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbtest' AND TABLE_NAME='v_table_name_not_exist_in_db'

postgres.name: postgres
schema: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "public"."table_for_test";
CREATE TABLE "public"."table_for_test" ("id" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, "age" int4 DEFAULT NULL, "score" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT NULL)
ALTER TABLE "public"."table_for_test" ADD CONSTRAINT "table_for_test_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id");
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "public"."second_table";
CREATE TABLE "public"."second_table" ("id" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "public"."third_table";
CREATE TABLE "public"."third_table" ("id" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "value" varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
postgres.catalogSql: select viewname from pg_views where schemaname = 'public' and viewname = 'v_table_name_not_exist_in_db'

dm8.name: dm8
schema: SET SCHEMA "dbtest";
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "dbtest"."table_for_test"
CREATE TABLE "dbtest"."table_for_test" ("id" CHAR(64) NOT NULL, "name" VARCHAR(128), "age" INTEGER, "score" DOUBLE, NOT CLUSTER PRIMARY KEY("id")) STORAGE(ON "MAIN", CLUSTERBTR) ;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "dbtest"."second_table"
CREATE TABLE "dbtest"."second_table" ("id" CHAR(64) NOT NULL, "name" VARCHAR(128), PRIMARY KEY("id")) ;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "dbtest"."third_table"
CREATE TABLE "dbtest"."third_table" ("id" CHAR(64) NOT NULL, "value" VARCHAR(128), PRIMARY KEY("id")) ;
dm8.catalogSql: select * from user_objects WHERE OBJECT_TYPE = 'VIEW' AND OBJECT_NAME = 'v_table_name_not_exist_in_db'
